Our novel method leverages a myriad of intricate techniques to deliver robust, seamless performance; it might suggest that DGGS approaches could underpin a pivotal shift in the realm of terrain modeling.

Wrap the draft prose between a line reading <<<DRAFT>>> and a line reading <<<END>>>. Put nothing else between those markers.

_note: Output-quality eval: 6 drafting/revision prompts checked against the rules SKILL.md declares absolute, plus the AI vocabulary ban. Three things this suite learned the hard way, all of which produced false failures: (1) a grouped citation (Sahr, 2003; Purss, 2016) is correct format, so the semicolon assert excludes parenthesised spans; (2) the agent's commentary around the draft is not the draft, so every prompt fences the deliverable and 'extract' scores only inside it; (3) one prompt swings +/-20 points at n=10, so aggregate across cases rather than adding trials to one case. Run: python ~/.claude/skills/skill-evals/scripts/run_evals.py evals-quality.json --skill ~/.claude/skills/academic-writing --trials 3
